title: Tropical Sri Lanka | FREE Excursion to Sigiriya
highlights: Discover Sri Lanka, from Kandy's cultural richness and Nuwara Eliya’s lush tea estates to Bentota’s pristine beaches and Colombo’s vibrant cityscape.
Witness the spectacular Kandyan Dance in Kandy, where traditional drumming and elaborate costumes bring ancient legends and rituals to life.
Visit the Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its stunning frescoes, impressive lion’s paws, and panoramic views of the surrounding landscape.
Discover the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a revered Buddhist shrine housing a sacred relic of Buddha’s tooth.
Wander through the Gangaramaya Temple in Colombo, known for its impressive collection of Buddhist artifacts and serene ambiance.
overview:
About the tour:
Sri Lanka is surrounded by elevated area lie sprawling plains the coastal areas are dotted with beautiful beaches and lagoons.Snuggled between the imposing mountains and verdant peaks Kandy is defined by the calmness and serenity. Spend your time at the holy relic of Buddha's tooth and surround yourself in the spiritual vibes,Often referred to as ‘Little England’, Nuwara Eliya is known for its colonial ambience where you can treasure trove of natural beauty and magnificent architectural buildings of Nuwara Eliya. The capital city is full of buildings and churches that are a majestic sight. Colombo flaunts a rich pilgrim legacy, highlighting a blend of races, religions and culture with sprawling bustling street markets. You will also get to visit other tourist hotspots like the Natural History Museum, Colombo Museum, Jami Ul-Alfar Mosque commonly referred as red mosque covered in elaborate stripes and patterns created by red and white painted bricks.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | En route visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Kandy | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon your arrival at the airport, board the transfer to Kandy. En route, visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage. Upon reaching Kandy, check in to your hotel and later, embark on a scenic drive around Upper Lake, offering picturesque views of the city from Kandy View Point. Also, admire the picturesque beauty of Kandy Lake before witnessing the vibrant Kandyan Dance performance, which includes a mesmerizing fire-walking ritual. Afterward, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show

days.title: Day Trip to Sigiriya
days.desc: In the morning, you'll be driven to the Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its unique Lion's Rock Fortress perched atop a massive rock column. As you explore, marvel at the intricate frescoes and the ancient engineering of the water gardens that surround the base. During the visit, you can opt to climb the 1,200 steps to the summit, where you'll be rewarded with panoramic views of lush forests and distant mountains. Afterward, you'll be driven back to your hotel.

days.title: Half-Day Kandy Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Nuwara Eliya
days.desc: Today, check out from the hotel and get transferred for a Kandy sightseeing tour. En route, visit the Bahirawakanda Vihara Buddha Statue, a towering white monument perched atop Bahirawakanda Hill and enjoy the panoramic views of Kandy. Also, stroll through the stunning Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens, home to a vast collection of exotic orchids and visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel in Nuwara Eliya and check-in.

items.title: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Stay at a Standard hotel
items.hotel: Tea Mount Forest Hotel, Nuwara Eliya

days.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Bentota
days.desc: Today, check out and board the transfer for a Nuwara Eliya sightseeing tour. First, visit the Seetha Amman Temple, dedicated to Seetha and believed to be the place where she was held captive by the demon king Ravana. Explore other sites such as Hakgala Botanical Garden, Victoria Park, and more. Don’t miss taking a leisurely stroll around Gregory Lake, soaking in its amazing beauty. Afterwards, continue to Bentota and, upon arrival, check in to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour

days.title: Day Trip to Galle and Mirissa
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get driven to Galle. Visit the Dutch Reformed Church, known for its colonial architecture, and the Galle Dutch Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Also, explore the Galle Fort Lighthouse and capture panoramic views of the coastline. Visit other sites before continuing to Mirissa, where you can relax at Mirissa Beach and enjoy a scenic walk to Coconut Tree Hill. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, check out and board the transfer to Colombo. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and later, get driven for a Colombo sightseeing tour. Begin with visiting Gangaramaya Temple, one of the oldest Buddhist temples in the city. Continue to other sites, including the Colombo Lotus Tower, the tallest structure in South Asia. Afterwards, explore the bustling Pettah Floating Market and enjoy a relaxing stroll through the Galle Face Green Beach. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After breakfast, pack your bags and check-out from the hotel. Get transferred to the airport for your flight. This is where your trip comes to an end.
